item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello, and welcome! Here's your weather for Wednesday, October 21. It's Wednesday, right in the middle of the week. Today in Shanghai, it will be a little bit rainy. The high will be 22 degrees, and the low will be 15 degrees. It will feel just right out there. Rain is about 100 percent likely today. Did you know today is day 294 of the year? There are 71 days to go until the new one. Remember to take an umbrella with you! As for tomorrow, expect it to be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 20 degrees. Remember, our theme this week is getting dark early. What have you noticed today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
